##Figure 1B Change in Air Quality 2025 average vs 2015 averagae Nation Wide - NO2 (EPA AIR DATA NO2)
```{r}

##Palette (Sequencial)
pal2 <- c("white", "#ECA19D","#DD5A54", "#AF2A23")

#DATA SETUP AND CLEANUP 
NO2Change <- read.csv("~/Documents/es_314/SOE_Report_F2026/Student Coding/Frida/Data/NO2_Percent_Change.csv")
class(NO2Change)

NO2Change_sf <- st_as_sf(
  NO2Change, 
  coords = c("Site.Longitude", "Site.Latitude"), 
  crs = 4326
)

# 2. Reproject to Massachusetts State Plane (6492)
NO2Change_sf <- st_transform(NO2Change_sf, crs = 6492)


NO2Change_sf$NO2.Percentage.Change <- as.numeric(gsub("%", "", NO2Change_sf$NO2.Percentage.Change))



```


 Prediction Grid
```{r}
# create prediction grid
options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)

ma <- states(cb = TRUE, year = 2023) |>
  subset(STUSPS == "MA")
suggest_crs(ma)
ma <- ma |> st_transform(6492)

grid <- terra::rast(ma, nrows = 200, ncols = 200)

xy <- terra::xyFromCell(grid, 1:ncell(grid)) |> as.data.frame()

pred_grid <- xy |> 
        st_as_sf( coords = c("x", "y"),
        crs = st_crs(grid))

# subset points that fall within 
pred_grid <- pred_grid[ma, ]

rm(xy)

```
 
Plotting IDW
```{r}


idw_model2 <- gstat(formula = NO2.Percentage.Change~ 1, 
             locations = NO2Change_sf,
             nmax = nrow(NO2Change_sf), # use all the wells locations
             set = list(idp = 2)) # beta = 2 

# Prediction Grid
 resp_idw2 <- predict(idw_model2, pred_grid) |>
  st_as_sf() |>
  mutate(pred = var1.pred) |> 
  vect()

pred_idw2 <- terra::rasterize(resp_idw2, grid, field = "pred", fun = "mean")

ggplot() +
  geom_spatraster(data = pred_idw2, aes(fill = mean)) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = pal2, na.value = "transparent", name = "%Change") +
  theme_minimal() + geom_sf(data = NO2Change_sf, aes(color = NO2.Percentage.Change),  shape = 21,       
    color = "black",  # Outline color
    size = 3,         # Point size
    stroke = 0.5      # Outline thickness
  ) + theme_minimal() + 
  theme(text = element_text(family = "Fraunces", size = 10,))



```
